question.html:
A planet is in a circular orbit around a star. The speed of the planet is constant. The following data are given:

Mass of planet                                      kg
Mass of star                                          kg
Distance from the star to the planet R  m.

A spacecraft is to be launched from the surface of the planet to escape from the star system. The radius of the planet is 9.1 × 103 km.

a Explain why a centripetal force is needed for the planet to be in a circular orbit. [2]

b Calculate the value of the centripetal force. [1]

c.i Show that the gravitational potential due to the planet and the star at the surface of the planet is about −5 × 109 J kg−1. [3]

c.ii Estimate the escape speed of the spacecraft from the planet–star system. [2]
